entities.summary: Malla, a notable figure in the history of Nepal, associated with Medieval Malla Kingdoms (1200–1482). Preceded by Early Malla Period. Their legacy influenced Jayasthiti Malla codifies the caste system and legal code of Nepal and Three Kingdoms Rivalry.
